+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Read data.csv, drop rows with age < 25, write cleaned.csv."""
+
+import csv
+
+MIN_AGE = 25
+
+
+def main():
+    with open("data.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
+
+    kept = [r for r in rows if int(r["age"]) >= MIN_AGE]
+
+    with open("cleaned.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["name", "age", "city"])
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(kept)
+
+    print(f"rows in: {len(rows)} | kept (age >= {MIN_AGE}): {len(kept)} | removed: {len(rows) - len(kept)}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
